text:
William Karlsson played only 14 games last season, so this is the first long look at him in a while, and the process is better than the line suggests. He has 10 points (6 goals) in 24 games at 17.6 minutes a night, but Vegas has scored 10.3 fewer goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice. At 5v5 the Golden Knights get 54.6% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him out there. That gap between chances and goals usually closes.

The finishing has started to arrive. Jesse Granger of The Athletic noted that a goal against Dallas on Nov. 20 was his third in two games. His own shooting, 12.8%, sits right in the middle of our range for him, so the goals are not a fluke either way.

He still plays a fast game (top-end speed in the 91st percentile), and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 87th percentile among forwards for chances from the home-plate area in front of the net last season. The 2023 Cup winner and former Lady Byng recipient has a season range from us of 31 to 52 points.
